message.content:
Based on the provided image, here is an exhaustive description of the UI mockup for the **ELD.TRIPPLANNER** application:

### 1. Overall Layout & Screen Type
*   **Screen Type:** This appears to be a **Header/Logo Banner**, likely used for a splash screen, app store listing, website header, or the top of a login/dashboard view. It is not a full functional interface but rather a branding element.
*   **Layout Structure:** The composition uses a clean, horizontal **flexbox-style layout**. It consists of two primary elements aligned on a single vertical center axis: an icon (app symbol) on the left and a text-based wordmark on the right.
*   **Background:** The background is a solid, flat **white** (`#FFFFFF`), providing high contrast for the dark elements.

### 2. Visual Elements: The Icon (Left Side)
*   **Shape:** A **rounded square** (squircle) with significantly curved corners.
*   **Background Color:** Deep **Navy Blue** (`#0B1D35` or similar).
*   **Border/Frame:** Inside the navy blue field, there is a prominent **dashed circular border**.
    *   **Color:** Bright **Safety Orange/Yellow** (`#F5A623` or `#FF9900`).
    *   **Style:** Thick dashed line, resembling a road marking or a loading spinner/target graphic.
*   **Central Graphic:** A stylized, flat-design icon of a **Semi-Truck (Tractor Trailer)** facing forward or slightly to the right.
    *   **Color:** Solid **White** (`#FFFFFF`).
    *   **Details:**
        *   A rectangular cab body.
        *   Two visible circular wheels with white fill and navy blue centers (implied by the cutout style) or simply white circles representing tires.
        *   A small orange/yellow accent on the top-right corner of the cab, possibly indicating a light or sun reflection.

### 3. Typography & Text Content (Right Side)
The text reads **"ELD.TRIPPLANNER"** in a single line.

*   **Font Family:** A modern, geometric **Sans-Serif** typeface (resembling Montserrat, Gotham, or Proxima Nova). It features uniform stroke weight and clean apertures.
*   **Text String:** "ELD.TRIPPLANNER"
*   **Color Breakdown:**
    *   **"ELD."**: Rendered in the same deep **Navy Blue** as the icon background.
    *   **"TRIP"**: Also rendered in **Navy Blue**.
    *   **"PLANNER"**: Rendered in a lighter **Medium Grey** (`#888888` or `#999999`). This creates a visual hierarchy where "ELD.TRIP" is emphasized as the core brand name, while "PLANNER" acts as a descriptor.
*   **Case:** All characters are **UPPERCASE**.
*   **Styling:** The font weight is **Bold** or **Extra Bold** (high weight), conveying stability and professionalism suitable for logistics software.

### 4. Spacing and Density
*   **Internal Padding (Icon):** The truck icon and dashed circle are well-padded within the blue rounded square, maintaining clear margins (approx. 15-20% padding).
*   **Element Spacing (Gapping):** There is distinct **negative space** (whitespace) between the right edge of the icon and the left edge of the "E" in ELD. This gap is roughly equal to the width of one or two characters, ensuring the logo and text do not feel cramped.
*   **Alignment:** The text is vertically centered relative to the icon. The baseline of the text aligns optically with the center of the icon.

### 5. Color Palette Summary
*   **Primary Brand Color:** Deep Navy Blue (Authority, Trust, Night driving).
*   **Secondary/Accent Color:** Safety Orange/Yellow (Caution, Visibility, Construction/Roads).
*   **Neutral Text:** White (for icons on dark bg) and Medium Grey (for secondary text on light bg).
*   **Canvas:** Pure White.

### 6. Missing Elements (Contextual Note)
Since this is strictly a **logo/banner mockup**, the following standard ELD interface elements are **NOT present** in this specific image:
*   **Map View:** No geographical map, routes, or GPS pins are visible.
*   **Log Grid:** No Electronic Logging Device (ELD) grid showing Duty Status (Off Duty, Sleeper Berth, Driving, On Duty) over a 24-hour timeline.
*   **Input Fields:** No fields for entering Hours of Service (HOS), shipper info, or coordinates.
*   **Buttons/KPIs:** No "Start Trip," "Stop," or violation warnings are visible.

### 7. Sample Data
There is no operational sample data. The only text data present is the static brand name: **ELD.TRIPPLANNER**.
